pool.text: Kochi rose to significance as a trading centre after Muziris was destroyed.
Italian traveller Niccolò Da Conti visited Kochi during his travels.
Portuguese navigator Pedro Álvares Cabral founded the first European settlement in India.
Fort Kochi Municipality was established by Dutch as the first municipality.
The Anglo-Dutch Treaty was signed, ceding Kochi to the United Kingdom.
Fort Kochi was made a municipality according to the Madras Act.
The construction of the Cochin Port transformed Kochi into a trading hub.
Cochin became the first princely state to join India willingly.
Travancore–Cochin state came into being with the merger of Cochin and Travancore.
The Ernakulam district was formed carving areas from erstwhile regions.
The Kochi Municipal Corporation came into existence on the state anniversary.
Peoples Council for Social Justice was found under patronage of Justice V.
The city reverted to a closer transcription of its original Malayalam name.
The Kochi International Book Festival began as an annual book event.
India's first art biennale, the Kochi-Muziris Biennale, started hosting visitors.
Cochin International Airport became the world's first fully solar-powered airport.
The metro line section from Aluva to Palarivattom was opened to passengers.
The airport received the United Nations Champions of the Earth award.
Arike home daycare program was started for extending palliative care services.
It finished building the first indigenous aircraft carrier for the Indian Navy.
